text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Arrrrgh! That hurts like something else!
Being
injured is the worst!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...I'm going to get back to training.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
If I take a break, I'll just fall behind
again—I'll be
left in the dust.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whatever. If I say I'm going, that's what
I'm gonna
do!
choice_data_list: 無理しないって約束できる？

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
What? I'm not gonna sit here for a
lecture.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: 悪化したらもっと差がつくぞ
悪化したらもっと差がつくよ

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Fine. I just need to rest, right? Fine!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No idea why you're thanking me. I
just
wanna win is all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan looks frustrated, but she
takes
some time to rest up.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: It's not like I want to push myself too hard. I know what happens if I—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ouch! Crap! Ooh, this is bad!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hurry to help her. It seems her injury
has gotten
worse.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: It's not like I want to push myself too hard. I know what happens if I do.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wooow! Like, I think it's working!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
How's this? If we just do some weight
training,
you shouldn't have any
complaints. Am I a genius
or what?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aha, so you get it. Make it a good one,
promise?
choice_data_list: 早速、筋トレメニューを組むよ！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Tosen Jordan maintains a
reasonable
training schedule and makes
a full recovery!
